criteria.requirement: Extend existing Token.match(ttype,values,regex=False,case_sensitive=None) with explicit strict bool or None policy. None preserves all legacy behavior (keyword normalized case-insensitive, names sensitive, exact token-type match). True compares original value exactly; False uses Unicode casefold for ordinary string matching. Regex uses original value with Python re.IGNORECASE only when explicitly insensitive, without casefolding regex patterns or altering their escapes; partial-match semantics stay. Support values generators, None/type mismatch, quoted tokens as explicitly chosen text and preserve token.value/normalized without mutation. Do not misreport the already-working default Keyword case matching as a bug.
